1879048833.desc: You auto-attack when dual-wielding one-handed weapons.

1879064065.name: Brutal Strikes
1879064065.desc: Makes three deadly attacks that are difficult to parry or evade.

1879064193.name: Inspire Fellows
1879064193.desc: Heals the Morale of the Fellowship.\n\nThis skill is not usable in Dissonance.

DNT - Critical Heals Proc an Induction Duration Buff

1879073537.name: Strength of Morale
1879073537.desc: In combat, the Race of Man is known for its unquenchable spirit.  This skill restores lost morale.

1879089793.name: Blood of the Dúnedain
1879089793.desc: Strength of morale can be called from the line of Elros even still in this dark time. This will restore morale to the Ranger.

conditionalEffects.description: Chord of Salvation will grant your target 1% of their Max Morale for every nearby ally.

1879109121.name: Essence of Winter
1879109121.desc: In writing, the significance of winter is that in time all things must slow, then stop. Lowers your foes' incoming healing and increases their skill Power cost.

1879111681.name: Sign of Power: See All Ends
1879111681.desc: Call upon your power of foresight, allowing you to avoid some incoming damage and masterfully using your staff to turn aside incoming blows.

1879145601.name: Guide to Echad Dúnann
1879145601.desc: Returns you and your Fellowship to Echad Dúnann in Eregion.\n\nThis skill is easily interrupted.

1879157633.name: Defender of All
1879157633.desc: An AOE force attack that also generates threat on all targets.

1879198337.name: Friend of Noble Birds (Tundra-eagle)
1879198337.desc: Summons an eagle companion.\n\nThe eagle is a noble creature which can deal damage and, if called upon, will sacrifice itself to save you.

1879207041.name: Steed of Bright Days
1879207041.desc: A brightly coloured theme sets this horse apart from the rest of the herd.

1879214593.name: Resolution
1879214593.desc: Even in the face of overwhelming numbers, your resolution dismays your foes, draining morale from enemies around you and restoring your morale.\n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Using will restore this skill to Battle Memory.</rgb>

1879222017.name: Nature's Bounty
1879222017.desc: The spirit overflows with bounty, shielding allies in close proximity.

1879240705.name: Discipline: Rohirrim
1879240705.desc:
<rgb=#66fff>Mounted Discipline</rgb>

Mounted Disciplines are used to alter the attitude and tactics used by your War-steed in Mounted Combat.

<rgb=#66ffff>Rohirrim</rgb>

The Rohirrim Discipline turns your focus on defending self, steed and others. Though your damage is lowered, your overall survival is improved.

1879248385.name: Spread of Arrows - Fire
1879248385.desc: Steadying yourself on your War-steed, you release several Fire-based projectiles toward your target.

1879262849.name: Crippling Shot
1879262849.desc: Seeing your enemy at a distance, you instinctively let loose an arrow, catching your foe off guard. \n\n<rgb=#FF7700>Increases Fervour by 1</rgb>

1879301249.name: Return to Aldburg
1879301249.desc: Thanks to your friendship with the Eorlingas, you're able to quickly return to Aldburg in western Rohan. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879305985.name: Steed of Odogil
1879305985.desc: A horse from the Anniversary Festival.

1879319169.name: Aurochs Calf
1879319169.desc: Summons an aurochs calf to your side. It wants to see the world past Ringló Vale.

1879324033.name: Brown Sheep
1879324033.desc: Summons a sheep to keep you company.

1879430401.name: Call Múta
1879430401.desc: Blow the horn to summon Múta to your side.

1879449985.name: Thrash - Tier 3 (Dual)
1879449985.desc: You maul the enemy with your sharp claws. Subsequent attacks deal more damage.

conditionalEffects.description: Each hit of Thrash increases the damage of the Beorning, stacking up to three times.

1879458177.name: Snow-covered Aurochs
1879458177.desc: Summons a snow-covered aurochs to accompany you on your journeys.

1879466241.name: Sail to the Brown Lands
1879466241.desc: Navigate to the Brown Lands with nearby fellows.

1879467265.name: Marked Foes
1879467265.desc:
Make a forceful cut across enemies before you, increasing the damage they take from all sources.

<rgb=#FF7700>Swordplay:
 Aggressive Strike deals more damage.
 Improves AoE Skill Damage.
</rgb>

<rgb=#FF7700>This effect does not stack with a Captain's Telling Mark.</rgb>

1879475969.name: Return to Jax Phanâl
1879475969.desc: You're able to quickly return to Jax Phanâl on the Cape of Umbar. This skill is easily interrupted.

1879489153.name: Wild Peck
1879489153.desc: Your companion makes a wild and damaging attack.

1879491073.name: Emerald Drakeling
1879491073.desc: Summons a friendly drakeling to accompany you on your adventures.

1879525377.name: Hollin Gate Fireworks
1879525377.desc: Set off some Hollin Gate-shaped fireworks!

1879527425.name: Broken Chain
1879527425.desc: Channel the power of broken chain to create a zone of protection against some of Thothrach's attacks. This power will also harm the user.

1879532417.name: Têtikir Ancestors
1879532417.desc: You call on your ancestors, instantly restoring 25% morale to yourself or a target.
